interpretation: Germany is not an availability desert. The plausible gap is consumer-accessible cross-brand lifecycle/obsolete-part discovery where manufacturer channels are fragmented or trade-gated.
Generic balcony solar is mature/saturated in Germany. Only second-order monitoring, compatibility, storage and special mounting should be researched.
The edge is transition/compatibility data, not generic hardware whitespace. A query/compatibility information layer may be more valuable than a store.
Generic Tesla/EV accessory thesis is weak. Only newly scaling exact-model cohorts with demonstrable seller lag should survive.
Germany itself is a mature diagnostics source market. Use these merchants as oracle templates for smaller target countries; Germany launch requires unusually narrow query/service gap.
